title: Poster-car dreams
description: Turbocharged ambition and unmistakable shapes for the bedroom wall.

cars.name: Ferrari F40
cars.description: Unveiled in 1987, the F40 brought Ferrari’s racing instincts to a dramatic road car. Its twin-turbocharged V8, lightweight construction and stripped-back cabin put performance first. The fixed rear wing and low, angular body made it one of the defining poster cars of the 1980s.

cost.basis: Good-to-excellent UK guide range for a standard 1988 F40. Competition conversions and exceptional provenance can command different prices.

cars.name: Porsche 959 Komfort
cars.description: The 959 made advanced engineering part of the supercar story. Its twin-turbocharged flat-six, all-wheel drive and carefully shaped body combined extraordinary performance with grand-touring comfort. The Komfort version represents Porsche’s sophisticated approach to the decade’s supercar rivalry, retaining a welcoming cabin beneath its unmistakable rear bodywork.

cost.basis: Good-to-excellent UK guide range for a Series 1 959 Komfort. Sport versions, later cars, mileage and specialist maintenance history affect value.

cars.name: BMW M3 E30
cars.description: Created with touring-car competition in mind, the original M3 transformed BMW’s compact two-door saloon with a high-revving four-cylinder engine and distinctive widened bodywork. The E30 generation balanced everyday practicality with motorsport purpose. Its boxy arches, rear wing and focused driving character became enduring signatures of the M badge.

cost.basis: Rounded UK guide range for good to excellent standard 2.3-litre E30 M3 examples. Evolution specials, Sport Evolution cars and competition histories are separate markets.

cars.name: DeLorean DMC-12
cars.description: Built in Northern Ireland, the DMC-12 paired stainless-steel exterior panels with dramatic gullwing doors and a rear-mounted V6. Its angular shape captured a futuristic vision of the sports car. Film fame later made the DeLorean a cultural icon, but the original road car remains a distinctive piece of 1980s design.

cost.basis: Rounded UK guide range for good to excellent standard DMC-12 examples. Transmission, restoration quality and chassis condition affect value; film-replica conversions are excluded.

cars.name: Peugeot 205 GTI 1.6
cars.description: The 205 GTI brought lively performance to Peugeot’s small three-door hatchback. Introduced in 1984, the 1.6-litre model combined a light body with fuel injection and an engaging chassis. Red trim, sporting seats and compact proportions helped turn a practical everyday car into one of the decade’s most recognisable hot hatches.

cost.basis: Rounded UK guide range for good to excellent 1986 1.6-litre 205 GTI examples. The later 1.9-litre variant, limited editions and modified cars have different values.
